Writing a Game Once

Write a game once: exact whole-number physics holds zero drift across Windows, macOS, and Linux, while GPU pixels stay behind a one-way gate.

[0 Replay Drift Across 3 OSes · 9/9 Suites Pass]

1/3 Using exact whole-number physics, one game blueprint replays identically for hours across Windows, macOS, Linux, and major engines.

2/3 Standard decimal math drifts across operating systems within 37 frames, and chaotic collisions quickly amplify tiny rounding gaps.

3/3 Graphics cards vary slightly pixel by pixel, so visual rendering must sit downstream behind a strict one-way tolerance gate.
